recommendations.name: PagerDuty Pre-Commit Risk Score
recommendations.description: A Claude Code plugin whose /risk-score command checks your uncommitted diff against 90 days of PagerDuty incident history and gives a 0-5 risk score with recommendations, but it needs a PagerDuty API key and a repo mapped to a PagerDuty service.

recommendations.name: pr-impact
recommendations.description: An open-source tool with a /pr-impact Claude Code command that scores your branch 0-100 from breaking changes, untested code, diff size, stale docs, config changes and impact breadth, with an optional GitHub Action to gate on a threshold (I could not open this page, so this comes from the search summary).

recommendations.name: PR Risk Scorer
recommendations.description: A GitHub Action plus a /score-pr slash command you copy into .claude/commands that scores your diff on complexity, size, coverage gap, dead code and migrations and returns a LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH tier.
